meta.parties: Wickremaratne and Another v. Alpenis Perera

rules.statement: A division of the land on the basis of convenience of possession does not result in the termination of co-ownership.
rules.supporting_quote: A division of the land on the basis of convenience of possession does not result in the termination of co-ownership. ...Very clear and strong evidence of ouster among co-owners is called for and separate, possession on grounds of convenience cannot be regarded as adverse possession for purposes of establishing prescriptive title.
